subject: next_cursor not null on last page

messages.name: Prestige Worldwide admin
messages.body: GET /v2/invoices returns a next_cursor on the last page, and the next call is empty.

messages.name: Nora (Support Tier 2)
messages.body: That's BUG-2200-04 (Medium). It's harmless but wasteful. It's fixed in 2.2.1, where next_cursor is null on the last page. Until then, stop when data comes back empty.
